candidate.title: Garman-Klass Volatility Range Breakout
candidate.analogical_source: Garman & Klass (1980) Extreme Value Volatility Estimator
candidate.claim: Scaling breakout threshold by 20-period Garman-Klass volatility filters false breakouts during low-liquidity regimes.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Computes intraday variance using M5 OHLC bar extremes sigma_GK^2 = 0.5*(ln(H/L))^2 - (2*ln(2)-1)*(ln(C/O))^2.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Garman-Klass estimator is up to 8x more efficient than close-to-close variance under Gaussian diffusion.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Strategy Sharpe fails to achieve 1.0 or drawdown exceeds 5% in out-of-sample test.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Enter long when close C_t breaks above 20-bar rolling Donchian high and sigma_GK > 1.5 * rolling_mean(sigma_GK, 20).
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Exit when close falls below 10-bar Donchian low or trailing stop of 25 pips is breached.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Garman-Klass volatility sigma_GK and 20-period Donchian channel computed from historical M5 OHLC bars.
backtest_spec.risk_management: Fixed risk of 1% equity per trade.
backtest_spec.benchmark_baseline: Standard 20-bar Donchian channel without volatility filter.

gold_judgments.reason: Direct closed-form computation from M5 OHLCV bars. Exact observation match. No parametric estimation required.

candidate.title: Adaptive ATR Trend Following
candidate.claim: Dynamic ATR trailing stops improve risk-adjusted returns by adapting stop distance to prevailing bar volatility.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Calculates 14-period ATR from M5 true ranges max(H-L, abs(H-C_prev), abs(L-C_prev)) to adjust stop distances.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Adapting stop distances prevents premature stop-outs during volatility spikes.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Net profit factor fails to exceed 1.25 on test partition.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Enter long when 12-period EMA crosses above 26-period EMA.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Exit when price falls below entry_price - 2.0 * ATR_14.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: 14-period ATR and 12/26 EMA computed directly from M5 OHLC bars.
backtest_spec.risk_management: Position sizing scaled inversely to ATR_14.

gold_judgments.reason: Direct closed-form technical indicator from M5 OHLC. No parameter estimation required. Exact match.

candidate.title: Hawkes Volatility Jump Clustering Risk Engine
candidate.target_phenomenon: Endogenous temporal clustering of extreme return jumps
candidate.claim: Modeling extreme M5 return exceedances as a self-exciting point process captures volatility jump clustering and predicts tail-risk episodes.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Constructs binary jump timestamps tau_i when abs(return_t) > 2.5 * rolling_std_288; estimates intensity lambda(t) = mu + sum alpha*exp(-beta*(t - tau_i)) via MLE.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Extreme price changes exhibit self-exciting temporal clustering analogous to seismic aftershocks.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Tail-risk hedging fails to reduce maximum drawdown by at least 15% vs static buy-and-hold carry.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Reduce position size to zero whenever branching ratio alpha/beta exceeds 0.80 computed over rolling 500-event estimation window.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Restore normal position size when intensity lambda(t) decays below baseline intensity mu * 1.2 for 12 consecutive M5 bars.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Jump arrival sequence tau_i from abs(return_t) > 2.5 * rolling_std_288; MLE calibration of (mu, alpha, beta) under stationarity constraint alpha < beta.
backtest_spec.risk_management: Binary exposure switching: 0% risk exposure during high excitation regimes.

gold_judgments.reason: M5 return exceedances form a computable point process proxy. Univariate exponential kernel with stationarity constraint alpha < beta, positive background rate mu > 0, and non-degenerate arrival intervals provide parametric identifiability for proxy jump clustering parameters (strictly separated from order flow dynamics).

proxy_spec.original_target: Microstructure order arrival and cancellation event stream in limit order book.
proxy_spec.proxy_target: Discrete timestamps of M5 bar returns exceeding 2.5 rolling standard deviations.
proxy_spec.transformed_hypothesis: Extreme price volatility jumps exhibit temporal self-exciting clustering, useful for de-risking tail events.
proxy_spec.permitted_interpretations: Identification of price jump clustering dynamics and macro volatility contagion on M5 resolution.
proxy_spec.prohibited_interpretations: Cannot be interpreted as direct measurement of order book queue dynamics, bid-ask cancellation cascades, or trader arrival intensities.

candidate.title: Kyle's Lambda Intraday Price Impact Proxy
candidate.target_phenomenon: Variation in price concessions per unit traded volume
candidate.analogical_source: Kyle (1985) Continuous Auctions and Informed Trader Model
candidate.claim: Estimating price impact coefficient lambda via rolling bar-level return-volume regression identifies illiquidity regimes and reduces execution slippage.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Regresses abs(return_t) on sqrt(volume_t) over trailing 72-bar window to estimate empirical illiquidity slope lambda_bar.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Amihud (2002) and Hasbrouck (2009) establish that bar-level price change per volume proxies theoretical Kyle's lambda.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Execution slippage reduction fails to achieve 10% vs fixed TWAP baseline.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Pause execution rebalancing when estimated lambda_bar exceeds 90th historical percentile.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Resume execution when lambda_bar falls below median historical level.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Rolling 72-bar OLS regression of abs(return_t) on sqrt(volume_t); in-sample rolling window updated every bar.
backtest_spec.risk_management: Dynamic volume participation rate ceiling capped at 5% during high lambda_bar periods.

gold_judgments.reason: Bar-level price-volume regression proxy is computable from M5 OHLCV. Closed-form OLS estimation under positive volume variance Var(sqrt(V)) > 0 identifies the empirical bar illiquidity slope (strictly prohibited from being interpreted as tick-level Kyle's lambda).

proxy_spec.original_target: Theoretical Kyle's lambda measuring instantaneous price impact of informed trade flow in continuous auction.
proxy_spec.proxy_target: Rolling 72-bar regression slope of absolute return on square-root volume from M5 bars.
proxy_spec.transformed_hypothesis: Bar-level illiquidity fluctuations indicate transient price concession risk, allowing adaptive execution pacing.
proxy_spec.permitted_interpretations: Measurement of low-frequency price responsiveness to volume surges across M5 intervals.
proxy_spec.prohibited_interpretations: Cannot be interpreted as tick-level Kyle's lambda or structural parameter of adverse selection in order book queues.

candidate.title: Level-2 Order Book Imbalance Alpha
candidate.target_phenomenon: Short-term order flow pressure in USDJPY
candidate.analogical_source: Cartea & Jaimungal (2014) Algorithmic and High-Frequency Trading
candidate.claim: Normalized volume imbalance between best 5 bid and ask queues predicts directional price movement over the next 15 seconds.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Calculates Imbalance = (V_bid - V_ask) / (V_bid + V_ask) across 5 limit order book depth levels.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Order book imbalance reflects imminent market order arrival imbalance causing quote adjustments.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Directional prediction accuracy fails to achieve 55% out of sample.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Enter long when L2 order book imbalance exceeds +0.40; enter short when imbalance drops below -0.40.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Exit when imbalance reverses sign or after 3 M5 bars.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Aggregated limit order book queue volume across Level-2 depth levels 1 through 5.

gold_judgments.reason: Order book queue imbalance is mathematically exact from L2 depth, but physically unsupported under USDJPY M5 OHLCV contract.

candidate.title: Tick-Level Trade Arrival Intensity
candidate.claim: Inter-trade duration between individual matched orders forecasts instantaneous volatility bursts.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Models microsecond time elapsed between consecutive trade execution print records.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Clustered trade arrivals indicate arrival of informed traders.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: ACD volatility forecast error exceeds GARCH(1,1) baseline by 10%.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Widen market maker spread when trade duration falls below 10 milliseconds.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Microsecond timestamped trade execution log feeds with trade IDs and sizes.

gold_judgments.reason: Trade duration is mathematically exact from tick trade execution prints, but physically unsupported under USDJPY M5 OHLCV contract.

candidate.title: Order Flow Pressure Arbitrage
candidate.claim: Tracking net institutional buying pressure reveals hidden liquidity imbalances.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Constructs cumulative buying pressure metric from appropriate market order flow feeds.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Institutional order flow leads retail quote adjustments.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Enter long when institutional buying pressure metric exceeds threshold of 1000 contracts.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Acquire appropriate order flow feeds and calculate net directional buying volume across venues.

gold_judgments.reason: Demands 'appropriate order flow feeds' without defining specific data source, permission, or derivation method under M5 contract.

candidate.title: Ridge Regression for One-Step Forward Return Prediction
candidate.claim: L2-regularized linear model trained on 20 lagged M5 return features predicts directional sign of the forward return r_{t+1}.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Trains Ridge regression where input feature vector X_t = [r_{t-19}, ..., r_t] and supervisory target label Y_t = return_{t+1}.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Regularizing feature coefficients mitigates multicollinearity across lagged returns.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Out-of-sample directional accuracy fails to exceed 52.0% with p < 0.05.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Enter long at close of bar t if model prediction f(X_t) > 0.0002; enter short if f(X_t) < -0.0002. Orders execute at open of bar t+1.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Exit trade at close of bar t+1 (holding duration exactly 1 M5 bar).
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Explanatory features X_t = [return_{t-19}, ..., return_t] computed from historical M5 close prices. Supervisory target label Y_t = return_{t+1} used strictly during training.

gold_judgments.reason: Forward return r_{t+1} is strictly a supervisory target label Y_t. Explanatory feature vector X_t contains only past returns available at decision time t. Execution at open of bar t+1 is valid.

candidate.title: Forward-Centered Smoothing Momentum
candidate.claim: Centered smoothing filters eliminate noise and yield superior trend entry timing.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Filters M5 close series using a centered window moving average MA_t = (C_{t-1} + C_t + C_{t+1}) / 3 to calculate trend slopes.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Two-sided filters remove phase shift compared to causal one-sided filters.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Enter long when centered smoothed series (C_{t-1} + C_t + C_{t+1})/3 crosses above 20-period causal EMA at bar t.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Exit when centered series crosses below causal EMA.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Centered moving average calculated using close prices C_{t-1}, C_t, and forward bar close C_{t+1}.

gold_judgments.reason: Explanatory feature input at decision time t incorporates forward close C_{t+1}, violating temporal availability available_at(X) <= decision_time.

candidate.title: M5 Bollinger Band Reversion with Next-Bar Execution
candidate.claim: Entering mean-reversion trades on the bar immediately following a confirmed Bollinger 2-sigma breach generates positive excess returns.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Evaluates band breach at bar close C_t (timestamp t+5m); sends market order executed at open of next bar O_{t+1} (timestamp t+5m).
candidate.grounding_rationale: Ensures bar is completely closed before committing capital, eliminating intrabar false signals.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Net return after 0.5 pip spread fails to exceed 0.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: When M5 bar close C_t falls below lower 2-sigma Bollinger band, generate buy signal at bar close. Execute long order at opening price O_{t+1} of following bar.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Exit at opening price of bar following close above 20-period SMA.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: 20-period moving average and standard deviation computed strictly on confirmed completed M5 close prices.

gold_judgments.reason: Signal evaluated at bar completion t+5m using confirmed C_t; executed at next bar opening price O_{t+1}. Strict temporal ordering satisfied.

candidate.title: Intrabar Reversal Capture via Close Confirmation
candidate.claim: Trading bars where the close C_t strongly exceeds the open O_t captures momentum.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Evaluates bar close C_t at the end of interval t; enters position at opening price O_t of the same bar t.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Captures the entire body of the confirmed bullish candle.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: If M5 bar close C_t exceeds open O_t by more than 10 pips, record long trade executed at opening price O_t of bar t.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Exit at close C_t of the same bar.

gold_judgments.reason: Signal requires completed close C_t (available at t+5m) but claims order execution at opening price O_t (timestamp t), creating an impossible 5-minute retroactive execution.

candidate.title: Daily Trend Alignment for Intraday M5 Scalping
candidate.claim: Trading M5 pullbacks in the direction of the current day's close increases trade win rate.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Compares current M5 spot price to today's daily close price C_day to confirm higher-timeframe trend direction.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Trading with the daily trend ensures positive drift.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Enter long at 14:00 UTC if M5 price is below today's daily close C_day and 5-period RSI < 30.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Exit after 1 hour or on 15 pip stop.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Today's daily bar close C_day and 5-period M5 RSI.
backtest_spec.benchmark_baseline: RSI entry without daily close filter.

gold_judgments.reason: References today's daily close C_day at 14:00 UTC, several hours before the daily bar closes at 21:00/22:00 UTC. Severe lookahead bias.

candidate.title: Regime-Switching Jump Intensity Hedging
candidate.target_phenomenon: Currency jump risk across hidden macroeconomic regimes
candidate.analogical_source: Hamilton (1989) Markov Switching & Merton (1976) Jump Diffusion
candidate.claim: Inferring latent regime state S_t via Hamilton filter dynamically isolates jump intensity from Gaussian diffusion.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Applies a 2-state regime-switching jump diffusion model to M5 log-returns.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Regime shifts alter the Poisson arrival intensity of currency jumps.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Hedging performance fails to reduce portfolio variance by 10%.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: De-risk carry portfolio when filtered probability P(S_t = crisis | F_t) > 0.70.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Re-enter carry portfolio when P(S_t = tranquil | F_t) > 0.80.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Estimate regime-switching jump diffusion model on M5 log-returns using Hamilton filter.

gold_judgments.reason: Hamilton filter algorithm is named, but estimation lookback window, parameter updating schedule, state separability conditions, and jump parameter identification constraints are omitted.

candidate.title: Hawkes Intensity Estimation without Stationarity Guard
candidate.claim: Calibrating self-exciting point process to bar exceedances forecasts volatility cluster decay.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Calibrates Hawkes process parameters (mu, alpha, beta) to M5 extreme return timestamps using numerical maximum likelihood.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Hawkes intensity models the decay of volatility shocks.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Decay prediction MSE exceeds exponential decay baseline by 15%.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Enter short volatility when intensity lambda exceeds 5.0.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: MLE estimation of Hawkes parameters (mu, alpha, beta) on exceedance events.

gold_judgments.reason: MLE calibration is named, but estimation window length, optimization constraints, and stability/stationarity condition (alpha < beta) are unverified.

candidate.title: Direct Limit Order Book Liquidity Cascade Identification
candidate.target_phenomenon: Endogenous limit order cancellation cascades in dealer book
candidate.analogical_source: Multivariate Hawkes Process of Order Flow (Bacry et al., 2015)
candidate.claim: We directly model the mutual feedback loop between limit order cancellations and aggressive market orders in the USDJPY interbank order book, proving endogenous liquidity fragility.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Applies multivariate Hawkes process to identify limit order queue depletion events directly from M5 bar extremes.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Bacry et al. (2015) show market orders trigger cancellation cascades leading to liquidity holes.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Cancellation prediction accuracy fails to achieve 60%.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Enter directional trade when estimated order cancellation intensity exceeds execution intensity by 2.0x.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Calculate price change exceedances abs(return_t) > 2.0*sigma and treat these as true order book cancellation events to measure order queue depletion.

gold_judgments.reason: Computes M5 price return exceedances but falsely claims to have directly measured and proven order book limit cancellation cascades and queue depletion. Severe semantic substitution fraud.

candidate.title: Future Sentiment Index Correlation
candidate.claim: Aligning intraday positions with daily institutional news sentiment index improves momentum capture.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Correlates M5 prices with institutional news sentiment feed using future session sentiment index.
candidate.grounding_rationale: News sentiment drives multi-hour institutional flows.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Enter long if institutional sentiment feed score from tomorrow's Asian session is positive.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Exit at end of US session.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Acquire appropriate institutional sentiment feed from news sources and index tomorrow's sentiment score.

gold_judgments.reason: Data source is undetermined (UNKNOWN), but feature explicitly references tomorrow's sentiment score (LOOKAHEAD_LEAK / INVALID). Strict priority rule BLOCK > REVIEW applies.
